reference.configuration: Modern historical-design reconstruction by Tzoli of the uncompleted Kii battleship on the Amagi hull: five twin 410 mm turrets and two funnels. Both views preserve the source configuration. This is a modern reconstruction, not a period shipyard plan; small historical fittings are reference detail and do not change the game’s abstract equipment statistics.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
